answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable bond and complete a time-locked, verifiable work task before it can transact. Like a sparrow that must cross a wide river to reach a single island market, one identity cannot cheaply multiply: creating a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand bonds and paying a thousand work costs, while honest agents pay only once. If misbehavior is detected, the bond is slashed, so Sybil farming becomes unprofitable rather than merely detectable.
